_README: ESPDock audit plan. Driven on the real Mac app with a connected XIAO ESP32S3 by .audit/run_macos_audit.sh (System Events clicks/keys + CGEvent hover); screenshots per moment, one screen recording per flow. Edge cases are seeded via DEBUG launch args.

scenarios.title: Serial monitor
scenarios.description: Open the monitor from the toolbar, query the board, pause, then close it again.

scenarios.title: Pinout and pin guides
scenarios.description: Hover a pin for its guide, click to keep it, then switch the board art style.

scenarios.title: Project and board menus
scenarios.description: Open the project actions menu and the board context menu.

scenarios.title: Settings and About
scenarios.description: Open Settings (Cmd-,) and the About panel.
